Quest: The Tyrant Ship and the Hakatha Meteor
Related Character(s): Bartholomew, Gregory, Tumak Swan, Sol Fortuna, Casey, Boogie
Current State: The crew cleared the hold and the garden shaft aboard the tyrant ship but chose to hold and rest, bloodied, before descending to the deck below.
Key Details (Player):
• [S03] Boatswain Tarto woke the crew at four in the morning to recover an adamantine meteor that struck the spire on Hakatha
• [S03] The plan: crew an abandoned beholder tyrant ship, install the helm on the command deck, and use its appearance to move through Hakathan space unchallenged
• [S03] The Flighty Foundling dropped the crew into the tyrant ship's cargo deck and departed
• [S03] The crew found and saved the broken autognome Ostekk-6, learning of a mimic aboard, a wisp bloom, and more clockwork horrors
• [S04] The crew dispatched the clockwork horrors feeding on Ostekk-6, saved it, and cleared the lantern-wisp bloom choking the garden shaft
• [S04] A magical floating dolly can bear the helm's weight, but the helm must still be routed up through the internal access shafts to the command deck
• [S04] Ostekk-6 confirmed the shafts are impassable while the bloom holds, and that killing a flower does not unmake the wisps already loose
• [S04] Bloodied and unrested, the crew decided for the first time not to press on, holding to recover before descending to the deck below by rope
Overview (Player): The crew has been sent to recover an adamantine meteor that struck the spire on Hakatha, a world of beholders. They board an abandoned tyrant ship to install a helm on its command deck and fly it through Hakathan space unnoticed — but the vessel is choked with a lantern-wisp bloom, prowled by clockwork horrors, and said to hide a shape-shifting mimic. The way up runs through its access shafts, and a deck below still waits unexplored.
Next Planned Beat: Rest, then descend to the deck below by rope and continue routing the helm up the access shafts to the command deck.
